title: AI Frontend Engineer
description:
About the company

Our client is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Amsterdam building a developer platform for quantum software: a programming language and compiler that make it much easier to write software for quantum computers. The core technology is in strong hands, with quantum scientists and an experienced founding engineer. What’s missing is the web platform, and that’s where you come in.
You’ll join a small, highly skilled team and work directly with experienced founders.

The role
You’ll be the first engineer to own the web side of the product, building the platform from scratch. The first users are researchers and scientists, and later enterprise teams. Your job is to make something deeply complex feel simple and clear.
No quantum background needed. You’ll learn that part on the job.

What you’ll do
Build the web platform from the ground up: architecture, frontend and user experience
Make complex technical results easy to understand through clear interfaces and visualisations
Build AI features with LLMs and agents that help users write, run and understand their programs
Work AI-first, using LLMs and agents in your daily work
Prototype quickly, test with users and iterate
Help decide what gets built and how it should feel
Work across the stack when needed

What you bring
Strong JavaScript/TypeScript and frontend skills (React preferred)
Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI agents
Experience building products or large features from scratch
Strong ownership, from idea to production
Product sense and a good eye for UX

Strong advantage
Developer tools, technical platforms or complex data interfaces
Early-stage startup experience
Deep tech or scientific users
Open-source contributions

What’s on offer
A founding-level role with real ownership
Competitive salary plus equity
Hybrid: 2–3 days a week in central Amsterdam
Flexible hours
No Dutch required

Good to know
You must already have the right to work in the Netherlands (no visa sponsorship)
industries: Software Development and IT System Custom Software Development
